issue_context.title: Add `mCaptcha` support
issue_context.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This issue is part of our "help wanted" issues. It represents something that we know we want to implement, and that is defined enough that a contributor can implement it in a way that it would get merged.
>
> If you want to work on this, please add a comment saying so and ask any questions you need, then open a PR referencing this issue!

## Description

Mastodon currently optionally supports hCaptcha. It would be useful to support other captcha providers, for example [mCaptcha](https://mcaptcha.org), which would allow people to self-host their captcha software, or the community to provide one for server admins.

## Implementation notes

For reference, the PR implemeting hCaptcha: https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/25019

This can be done by adding additional environment variables, like `MCAPTCHA_TOKEN`, `MCAPTCHA_INSTANCE_URL`…

The active captcha provider would be selected based on which environment variables are configured. The frontend could bundle the `@mcaptcha/vanilla-glue` library (3.5kb before gzip), or we could dynamically import either hcaptcha or mcaptcha JS depending on what is configured on the instance.
comments:
As an advocate for "shared services"... wonderful idea. I'll host a mCaptcha node from day 0, I'd love to have a list of known good mCaptcha endpoints for mastodon/fediverse usage.

Edit: https://mcaptcha.upright.network feel free to use for testing.

Hello 👋 

I would like to work on this. 

My understanding is that the implementation details would be as follows:
1. The Ruby/Rails gem for `mCaptcha` will be added to the `Gemfile`
2. Include the equivalent of `include Hcaptcha::Adapters::ViewMethods` for `mCaptcha` in `app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb`
3. Add an equivalent `verify_mcaptcha` for the method `check_captcha!` in [`app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb`](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb#L31) Or maybe rework the method to have a more generic check?
4. Add a `.m-captcha` style class similar to the one [here](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/app/javascript/styles/mastodon/forms.scss#L1090)
5. Add another locale entry similar to [this one](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/config/locales/en.yml#L761-L763) but for `mCaptcha`. Alternatively, similar to point 3 above, rework the message to generally apply to either `hCaptcha` or `mCaptcha`.

If I've missed anything or there's something I should consider or add, please let me know 😇 
Otherwise thanks in advance for your feedback 🙏

> 1. The Ruby/Rails gem for `mCaptcha` will be added to the `Gemfile`

There is no `mCaptcha` gem from what I know, there will be a need to implement an internal Ruby class/module for the mCaptcha backend interactions

> 2. Include the equivalent of `include Hcaptcha::Adapters::ViewMethods` for `mCaptcha` in 
`app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb`

Same as above, this will need to be created

> 3. Add an equivalent `verify_mcaptcha` for the method `check_captcha!` in [`app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb`](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/app/controllers/concerns/auth/captcha_concern.rb#L31) Or maybe rework the method to have a more generic check?

There will probably be a need for a `verify_captcha` method, that either calls the existing `verify_hcaptcha` or a new `verify_mcaptcha` depending on the configuration

> 4. Add a `.m-captcha` style class similar to the one [here](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/app/javascript/styles/mastodon/forms.scss#L1090)

If there is a need for a custom class to style mCaptcha, yes, but this is an implementation detail

> 5. Add another locale entry similar to [this one](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/config/locales/en.yml#L761-L763) but for `mCaptcha`. Alternatively, similar to point 3 above, rework the message to generally apply to either `hCaptcha` or `mCaptcha`.

This message will need to be adapted depending on if mCaptcha or hCaptcha is enabled from the environment variables

Gave this a go in [this PR](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/pull/33524) and came to the following conclusion:

Anyone who takes this up needs to determine whether it would make sense to use a gem implementation directly instead of trying make the required files in the Mastodon codebase. The PR has details regarding this but (most likely) because I use a [Docker setup](https://github.com/mastodon/mastodon/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#docker), it may be that troubleshooting what was wrong became more complex than it would have been.

Maybe at a later point, I'll re-visit the issue and try to finish it in one go. Happy to help with reviewing, testing etc if someone else picks it up.
